glossary.ja: オーガニック・エナジー
glossary.role: The life-energy produced by Orphan and the Antibodies (Brain Powerds and Grand Chers); researched by the Isami family

glossary.ja: バロン・マクシミリアン
glossary.role: Masked figure who seizes control of Orphan in Jonathan's name and gives him the Baronz; secretly Anoa McCormick, the missing captain of Novis Noah
glossary.personality: Mysterious, theatrical and manipulative. Acts as a mentor to Jonathan, driven by a twisted longing for her estranged son.

glossary.role: Giant 'Hyper' form of the Wryneck (boss unit; Todd's hyper-ized Wryneck)
The otherworld between sea and land where Dunbine takes place.
Class of insect-like Byston Well mecha fielded by the Drake Army and Show's side.
Aura battleship of Queen Ciela Lapana (Kingdom of Na)
Aura battleship of Bishot Hatta, King of Ku; an enemy ship in Operation 25.

glossary.series: Super Dimension Fortress Macross: Do You Remember Love?
glossary.role: Race/faction of giant humanoid warriors; main antagonists.
Anti-Orphan battleship (carrier with a pyramid superstructure); base of the Brain Powerd pilots
Modified Gun Ark with an evolving Guardian System and fallen-angel styling; Marina's unit while with the Rainen side.
Organic mecha born from Orphan plates (Grand Chers and Brains).
Collective term for all aura-powered machines (Aura Battlers, aura ships) of the Drake Army.
Evolved Antibody created by reviving a Grand Cher (e.g. Jonathan Baronz, Quincy Baronz).
Class of Drake-side aura ship; a weaker cousin of the aura battleships.
The people who serve Orphan and pilot Grand Chers to gather its plates; plural 'Reclaimers'
MSC-07 Pegasus-class Federation assault carrier commanded by Sinapus.
Gigantic sentient alien ship buried under the Pacific; its awakening threatens Earth; base of the Reclaimers
The aura energy of a pilot; also the name of a Dunbine-family ability that multiplies attack power for a while (Weapon 6).
Earth Federation captain (Captain, 大佐) of the assault carrier Albion; leads the pursuit of the stolen GP02.
glossary.personality: Grizzled veteran with a commanding presence and keen tactical mind; relies on his own judgement and sense of right and wrong.

glossary.role: Main antagonist; Lord of House Luft in the Kingdom of Ah (アの国), who summons Holy Warriors and wages war to unite Byston Well; commands the Will Wipps
glossary.personality: Ambitious, scheming warlord who believes his conquest is justified. Loves his daughter Riml but is blind to the plots around him.

glossary.role: Life energy of Byston Well that powers aura machines; used alone in lines like オーラの力 / 悪しきオーラ / オーラ光.
Masked figure who seizes control of Orphan in Jonathan's name and gives him the Baronz; secretly Anoa McCormick, the missing captain of Novis Noah
glossary.personality: Mysterious, theatrical and manipulative. Acts as a mentor to Jonathan, driven by a twisted longing for her estranged son.

glossary.role: Short for Brain Powerd units (ブレンたち, ブレンパワード隊).
ACE2 heroine; Ensign in Tak's squad, pilot of the red Gun Ark; goes missing at Torrington Base, reappears with the Rainen Project in the Buster Ark, later rejoins Tak.
glossary.personality: Cool and reserved ('defrosting ice queen' in flashbacks); deeply bonded with Tak.

glossary.role: Female lead; 17-year-old Brain Powerd pilot (Hime Brain) aboard the Novis Noah
glossary.personality: Cheerful, warm and motherly toward the children and her Brain. Optimistic and brave, and believes in talking to people and Antibodies alike.

31.speaker: Irene Carrier
31.role: acting captain of the Novis Noa
31.evidence: brief: 'ノヴィス・ノアの艦長代理、アイリーン・キャリアーです。'

37.speaker: Eyphar Sinapus
37.evidence: brief: '私が本艦の艦長、エイパー・シナプスだ。'

54.speaker: Ciela Lapana
54.evidence: brief: '私は、ナの国の女王、シーラ・ラパーナです。'

rows.jp: オペレーション　２５
rows.en: Operation 25
rows.notes: Strategic briefing title.

rows.jp: オルファン浮上
rows.en: Orphan Rises
rows.notes: Strategic briefing operation title.

rows.jp: ブル・ベガー特攻阻止
rows.en: Stop Bull Beggar Suicide Attacks
rows.notes: Objective text.

rows.jp: ゲア・ガリング攻撃
rows.en: Attack the Gea Garing
rows.notes: Objective text.

rows.jp: ノヴィス・ノア進軍援護
rows.en: Support Novis Noah's Advance
rows.notes: Objective text.

rows.jp: バロン・ズゥ撃破
rows.en: Defeat Baron Zu
rows.notes: Objective text.

rows.jp: ドレイク軍せん滅
rows.en: Annihilate the Drake Forces
rows.notes: Objective text.

rows.jp:
<op(31,1)><sp(2)><ac(24)>太平洋方面で<im(1)>緊急事態<im(2)>です。
海底から浮上していたオルファンが、
突然高度を上げ、再浮上を始めました。
rows.en:
<op(31,1)><sp(2)><ac(24)>An emergency has arisen <im(1)>in the Pacific.<im(2)>
Orphan, having risen from the seabed,
suddenly gained altitude and resumed ascending.
rows.notes: Irene Carrier briefing. Exact tokens preserved.

rows.jp:
<op(31,1)><sp(2)>とうとう恐れていたことが起こりました…
このままではオルファンは宇宙へと
飛び立ってしまいます。
rows.en:
<op(31,1)><sp(2)>What we feared has finally come to pass...
At this rate, Orphan will take off
into space.
rows.notes: Irene Carrier briefing. Exact tokens preserved.

rows.jp:
<op(31,1)><sp(2)>#c[BE5050]リクレイマー#c内では最近、ガバナーと名乗る
指導者が、<im(18)>バロン・マクシミリアンという人物の
クーデターにより失脚しています。
rows.en:
<op(31,1)><sp(2)>Within the #c[BE5050]Reclaimers#c, the leader called Governor
was recently ousted in a coup <im(18)>staged
by a figure named Baron Maximilian.
rows.notes: Irene Carrier briefing. Exact tokens preserved.

rows.jp:
<op(31,1)><sp(2)><im(13)>#c[BE5050]リクレイマー#cが思い切った行動に出たのは、
この動きの一部として理解できるのですが…
#c[BE5050]ドレイク#cがこれを静観するとは思えません。
rows.en:
<op(31,1)><sp(2)><im(13)>That the #c[BE5050]Reclaimers#c took drastic action can be
understood as part of this development, but...
I cannot believe #c[BE5050]Drake#c will just watch idly.
rows.notes: Irene Carrier briefing. Exact tokens preserved.

rows.jp:
<op(31,1)><sp(2)>オルファン奪取に動くのか、
それとも何か別の手を打ってくるのか、
現状では何とも･･･
rows.en:
<op(31,1)><sp(2)>Whether he moves to seize Orphan or plays some
other hand, we cannot say for certain right now...
rows.notes: Irene Carrier briefing. Exact tokens preserved.

rows.jp:
<op(31,1)><sp(2)><im(3)>しかし、このままオルファンの浮上を許すと、
取り返しのつかない事態になります。
rows.en:
<op(31,1)><sp(2)><im(3)>However, if we permit Orphan to continue ascending,
irreversible disaster will strike.
rows.notes: Irene Carrier briefing. Exact tokens preserved.

rows.jp:
<op(31,1)><sp(2)>地球上のオーガニック・エナジーが
全て吸収され、地球の全生命が
死滅してしまうかもしれません。
rows.en:
<op(31,1)><sp(2)>All Organic Energy on Earth could be absorbed,
and all life on the planet might perish.
rows.notes: Irene Carrier briefing. Exact tokens preserved.

rows.jp:
<op(31,1)><sp(2)>一方で、#c[5E8FD8]ノヴィス･ノア#cのほうでも
奇妙な事件がありました。
rows.en:
<op(31,1)><sp(2)>Meanwhile, a strange incident occurred
aboard the #c[5E8FD8]Novis Noah#c as well.
rows.notes: Irene Carrier briefing. Exact tokens preserved.

rows.jp:
<op(31,1)><sp(2)>ブレンたちが勝手に動き出し、
オルファンへの道を開いたのです。
rows.en:
<op(31,1)><sp(2)>The Brains moved on their own initiative
and opened a path toward Orphan.
rows.notes: Irene Carrier briefing. Exact tokens preserved.

rows.jp:
<op(31,1)><sp(2)>比瑪ちゃんはこれを見て、
ブレンたちとオルファンは
心を通じ合わせているのではないか…
rows.en:
<op(31,1)><sp(2)>Seeing this, Hime wondered whether the Brains
and Orphan might be communicating with
one another on a heart-to-heart level...
rows.notes: Irene Carrier briefing. Exact tokens preserved.

rows.jp:
<op(31,1)><sp(2)>そして、それと同じように人間にも
オルファンを説得できるのではないかと
考えたようです。
rows.en:
<op(31,1)><sp(2)>And by that same token, she believes that humans
too might be capable of persuading Orphan.
rows.notes: Irene Carrier briefing. Exact tokens preserved.

rows.jp:
<op(31,1)><sp(2)>彼女と勇で、オルファンの説得を試みて
もらおうと思います。
オルファンは、必ず理解してくれます。
rows.en:
<op(31,1)><sp(2)>I intend to have her and Yuu attempt to persuade
Orphan. I am certain Orphan will understand.
rows.notes: Irene Carrier briefing. Exact tokens preserved.

rows.jp:
<op(37,1)><sp(2)>正直、信じがたい話ではあるが、
オルファンやアンチボディについては
彼らのほうが専門だ。
rows.en:
<op(37,1)><sp(2)>Frankly, it is difficult to believe, but when
it comes to Orphan and Antibodies,
they are the specialists.
rows.notes: Captain Sinapus briefing. Exact tokens preserved.

rows.jp:
<op(37,1)><sp(2)><im(6)><im(9)>オルファンへの対応については
彼らの判断を全面的に支持する。
rows.en:
<op(37,1)><sp(2)><im(6)><im(9)>Regarding our handling of Orphan,
I fully support their judgment.
rows.notes: Captain Sinapus briefing. Exact tokens preserved.

rows.jp:
<op(37,1)><sp(2)><im(10)><im(11)>#c[F07141]敵の迎撃#cについては、我々#c[5E8FD8]アルビオン#cが
引き受ける。#c[5E8FD8]ノヴィス・ノア#cによる説得を
成功させるために、全力を尽くそう。
rows.en:
<op(37,1)><sp(2)><im(10)><im(11)>Regarding #c[F07141]intercepting the enemy#c, our #c[5E8FD8]Albion#c
shall take it on. Let us do everything so the
#c[5E8FD8]Novis Noah#c's persuasion will succeed.
rows.notes: Captain Sinapus briefing. Exact tokens preserved.

rows.jp:
<op(54,1)><sp(2)>問題は#c[BE5050]ドレイク軍#cです。
オルファンが動き出したことには、
おそらく彼らも関係しています。
rows.en:
<op(54,1)><sp(2)>The issue is the #c[BE5050]Drake Forces#c.
They are likely involved in Orphan's sudden
movement as well.
rows.notes: Queen Ciela: regal, no contractions. Exact tokens preserved.

rows.jp:
<op(54,1)><sp(2)><im(19)>#c[BE5050]ドレイク#cが放つ悪しきオーラ。
そして、#c[BE5050]ゼントラーディ#cの接近…
それらが何かしら影響を与えたのでしょう。
rows.en:
<op(54,1)><sp(2)><im(19)>The evil aura cast by #c[BE5050]Drake#c, and the approach
of the #c[BE5050]Zentradi#c... These factors have surely
exerted some manner of influence.
rows.notes: Queen Ciela: regal, no contractions. Exact tokens preserved.

rows.jp:
<op(54,1)><sp(2)>#c[BE5050]ドレイク#cは地上制圧のため、
オルファンを我が物にしようとするに
違いありません。
rows.en:
<op(54,1)><sp(2)>In order to conquer the surface world,
#c[BE5050]Drake#c will without doubt seek to claim
Orphan for himself.
rows.notes: Queen Ciela: regal, no contractions. Exact tokens preserved.

rows.jp:
<op(54,1)><sp(2)>オルファンやアンチボディが、オーラ力に
似たオーガニック・エナジーで動くことに
目をつけたのだと思います。
rows.en:
<op(54,1)><sp(2)>I believe his eyes were drawn to how Orphan
and Antibodies operate on Organic Energy,
which closely resembles Aura Power.
rows.notes: Queen Ciela: regal, no contractions. Exact tokens preserved.

rows.jp:
<op(54,1)><sp(2)>アンチボディとオーラバトラーが
ともに戦うことで、互いに力を増幅させる
という現象も起きているようです。
rows.en:
<op(54,1)><sp(2)>It appears that when Antibodies and Aura Battlers
fight side by side, a phenomenon occurs wherein
they mutually amplify each other's power.
rows.notes: Queen Ciela: regal, no contractions. Exact tokens preserved.

rows.jp:
<op(54,1)><sp(2)>もしかするとオーラバトラーと
アンチボディは、きわめて近しい
存在なのかもしれません。
rows.en:
<op(54,1)><sp(2)>Perhaps Aura Battlers and Antibodies
are remarkably similar entities.
rows.notes: Queen Ciela: regal, no contractions. Exact tokens preserved.

rows.jp:
<op(54,1)><sp(2)>#c[BE5050]ドレイク#cは現在、<im(14)>オルファン周辺に
軍勢を集結させています。
rows.en:
<op(54,1)><sp(2)>#c[BE5050]Drake#c is currently <im(14)>massing his military forces
around Orphan.
rows.notes: Queen Ciela: regal, no contractions. Exact tokens preserved.

rows.jp:
<op(54,1)><sp(2)>あの海域には数々の怨念や野望、憎悪を
感じます。
このまま放置しては、何が起こるか…
rows.en:
<op(54,1)><sp(2)>I sense countless grudges, ambitions, and hatreds
in that sector of the sea. If left unattended,
there is no telling what may occur...
rows.notes: Queen Ciela: regal, no contractions. Exact tokens preserved.

rows.jp:
<op(54,1)><sp(2)>同じバイストン・ウェルから来た者として、
この地上で、これ以上#c[BE5050]ドレイク#cの
好きにさせておくわけにはまいりません。
rows.en:
<op(54,1)><sp(2)>As one who also hails from Byston Well, I cannot
permit #c[BE5050]Drake#c to have his way upon this
surface world any longer.
rows.notes: Queen Ciela: regal, no contractions. Exact tokens preserved.

rows.jp:
<op(54,1)><sp(2)>何としても#c[F07141]ドレイクの野望を打ち砕かねば#c。
シナプス艦長、どうか力をお貸しください。
rows.en:
<op(54,1)><sp(2)>We must #c[F07141]crush Drake's ambitions#c at all costs.
Captain Sinapus, pray lend us your strength.
rows.notes: Queen Ciela: regal, no contractions. Exact tokens preserved.

rows.jp:
<op(37,1)><sp(2)>今回は#c[5E8FD8]ＵＣＥ#cの主力艦がほぼ揃った、
総力戦となるだろう。
rows.en:
<op(37,1)><sp(2)>Nearly all of the #c[5E8FD8]UCE#c's capital ships are gathered.
This will be an all-out fleet engagement.
rows.notes: Captain Sinapus briefing. Exact tokens preserved.

rows.jp:
<op(37,1)><sp(2)>各自、#c[5E8FD8]友軍艦#cへの被害を最小<im(16)>限に
抑え<im(17)>るよう、<of(1)>作戦行動を展開して欲しい。
rows.en:
<op(37,1)><sp(2)>I ask everyone to keep damage to #c[5E8FD8]allied ships#c
to a mini<im(16)>mum<im(17)> as you conduct operations.<of(1)>
rows.notes: Captain Sinapus briefing. Exact tokens preserved.

rows.jp:
<op(54,1)><sp(2)>#c[BE5050]ドレイク軍#cの<im(1)>#c[BE5050]オーラバ<im(3)>トラー隊#cが、
<im(6)>#c[5E8FD8]グラ<im(8)>ン・<im(10)>ガラ<im(12)>ン#cに向かって来ています。
#c[F07141]彼らの阻止#cに出<im(4)>てく<im(5)>ださい。<tr(1)>
rows.en:
<op(54,1)><sp(2)>The #c[BE5050]Drake Army#c's <im(1)>#c[BE5050]Aura Bat<im(3)>tler Squad#c is heading<im(6)>
toward the #c[5E8FD8]Gra<im(8)>n-<im(10)>Gara<im(12)>n#c.
Please deploy to #c[F07141]intercept them#c.<im(4)><im(5)><tr(1)>
rows.notes: Queen Ciela briefing. Exact tokens preserved.

rows.jp:
<op(54,1)><sp(2)>敵の先鋒は#c[BE5050]オーラマシン#cと、
#c[BE5050]ブル・ベガーの大群#cで構成されて<im(14)>います。
いったい何を企んでいるのか……
rows.en:
<op(54,1)><sp(2)>The enemy vanguard consists of #c[BE5050]Aura Machines#c
and a massive swarm of #c[BE5050]Bull Beggars#c.<im(14)>
Whatever could he be plotting...?
rows.notes: Queen Ciela briefing. Exact tokens preserved.

rows.jp: グラン･ガランの撃沈
rows.en: Gran-Garan Sunk
rows.notes: Objective failure display.

rows.jp: ハイパーライネックの撃破
rows.en: Defeat Hyper Rynck
rows.notes: Objective display.

rows.jp: グラン・ガラン
rows.en: Gran-Garan
rows.notes: Unit label.

rows.jp: <op()><sp(20)>ブルベガー、多数接近！<ab(400)><ed()>
rows.en: <op()><sp(20)>Multiple Bull Beggars approaching!<ab(400)><ed()>
rows.notes: Operator warning. Exact tokens preserved.

rows.jp: <op()><sp(20)>こちらに特攻をかけるつもりです。<ab(500)>
rows.en: <op()><sp(20)>They intend to launch suicide attacks on us.<ab(500)>
rows.notes: Bridge report. Exact tokens preserved.

rows.jp: <sp(20)>ドレイクは兵を殺人兵器に仕立てている！<ab(400)><ed()>
rows.en: <sp(20)>Drake has turned his soldiers into suicide weapons!<ab(400)><ed()>
rows.notes: Pilot indignation. Exact tokens preserved.

rows.jp: <op()><sp(20)>アルビオンとグラン・ガランに近づけるな！<ab(600)>
rows.en: <op()><sp(20)>Keep them away from Albion and Gran-Garan!<ab(600)>
rows.notes: Commander order. Exact tokens preserved.

rows.en: <sp(20)>Shoot them down!<ab(200)><ed()>
rows.notes: Combat command. Exact tokens preserved.

rows.jp: <op()><sp(20)>人が乗ったまま体当たりするの！？<ab(300)>
rows.en: <op()><sp(20)>They are ramming with pilots still inside?!<ab(300)>
rows.notes: Pilot shock. Exact tokens preserved.

rows.jp: <sp(20)>ウソでしょ！？　だめだよ、そんなこと！<ab(300)><ed()>
rows.en: <sp(20)>Are you kidding?! They cannot do that!<ab(300)><ed()>
rows.notes: Pilot disbelief. Exact tokens preserved.

rows.jp:
<op()><sp(20)>オーラマシンよりも
ブルベガーを優先して落とすんだ！<ab(500)><ed()>
rows.en:
<op()><sp(20)>Prioritize the Bull Beggars over Aura Machines!
Shoot them down first!<ab(500)><ed()>
rows.notes: Tactical instruction. Exact tokens preserved.

rows.jp: <op()><sp(20)>なんで、こんなひどい作戦を……<ab(200)><ed()>
rows.en: <op()><sp(20)>Why carry out such a terrible tactic...?<ab(200)><ed()>
rows.notes: Pilot horror. Exact tokens preserved.

rows.jp: <op()><sp(20)>人を人と思わない。<ab(100)>
rows.en: <op()><sp(20)>He does not care about human life.<ab(100)>
rows.notes: Pilot grim line. Exact tokens preserved.

rows.jp: <sp(20)>それがドレイクのやり方なのよ。<ab(500)><ed()>
rows.en: <sp(20)>That is Drake's way.<ab(500)><ed()>
rows.notes: Marvel or pilot line. Exact tokens preserved.

rows.en: <op()><sp(20)>Additional enemy warships detected!<ab(100)><ed()>
rows.notes: Operator alert. Exact tokens preserved.

rows.jp: <op()><sp(20)>熱源反応、さらに増大！<ab(100)><ed()>
rows.en: <op()><sp(20)>Thermal signatures increasing further!<ab(100)><ed()>
rows.notes: Operator sensor alert. Exact tokens preserved.

rows.jp: <op()><sp(20)>グラン・ガラン、被弾！<ab(100)><ed()>
rows.en: <op()><sp(20)>Gran-Garan has taken a hit!<ab(100)><ed()>
rows.notes: Damage report. Exact tokens preserved.

rows.jp: <op()><sp(20)>グラン・ガラン、被弾！<ab(100)>
rows.en: <op()><sp(20)>Gran-Garan has taken a hit!<ab(100)>
rows.notes: Bridge alert. Exact tokens preserved.

rows.jp: <sp(20)>ブリッジ付近が損傷！<ab(200)><ed()>
rows.en: <sp(20)>Damage sustained near the bridge!<ab(200)><ed()>
rows.notes: Bridge report. Exact tokens preserved.

rows.jp: <op()><sp(20)>この程度で、グラン・ガランは沈みません。<ab(500)><ed()>
rows.en: <op()><sp(20)>Gran-Garan will not sink from something like this.<ab(500)><ed()>
rows.notes: Queen Ciela: regal, no contractions. Exact tokens preserved.

rows.jp: <op()><sp(20)>グラン･ガラン、損傷拡大！<ab(100)>
rows.en: <op()><sp(20)>Gran-Garan damage spreading!<ab(100)>
rows.notes: Damage report. Exact tokens preserved.

rows.jp: <sp(20)>推進力が低下しています！<ab(300)><ed()>
rows.en: <sp(20)>Propulsion is decreasing!<ab(300)><ed()>
rows.notes: Engine status. Exact tokens preserved.

rows.jp: <op()><sp(20)>力押しでは被害を増やすだけです。<ab(100)><ed()>
rows.en: <op()><sp(20)>Relying on brute force will only add casualties.<ab(100)><ed()>
rows.notes: Bridge tactical advice. Exact tokens preserved.

rows.jp: <op()><sp(20)>グラン・ガラン、撃沈！<ab(500)><ed()>
rows.en: <op()><sp(20)>Gran-Garan has been sunk!<ab(500)><ed()>
rows.notes: Mission failure notice. Exact tokens preserved.

rows.jp: <op()><sp(20)>なんということだ……<ab(900)><ed()>
rows.en: <op()><sp(20)>How could this happen...<ab(900)><ed()>
rows.notes: Despair over sinking. Exact tokens preserved.

rows.en: <op()><sp(20)>Port side hit!<ab(100)>
rows.notes: Albion bridge alert. Exact tokens preserved.

rows.jp: <sp(20)>損傷は軽微です！<ab(100)><ed()>
rows.en: <sp(20)>Damage is minor!<ab(100)><ed()>
rows.notes: Albion bridge status. Exact tokens preserved.

rows.jp: <op()><sp(20)>直撃！　左舷、ＭＳカタパルト！<ab(100)><ed()>
rows.en: <op()><sp(20)>Direct hit! Port MS catapult!<ab(100)><ed()>
rows.notes: Albion combat alert. Exact tokens preserved.

rows.jp: <op()><sp(20)>本艦の損傷が拡大しています！<ab(300)>
rows.en: <op()><sp(20)>Damage to this ship is spreading!<ab(300)>
rows.notes: Damage report. Exact tokens preserved.

rows.jp: <sp(20)>これでは艦がもたない……！<ab(500)><ed()>
rows.en: <sp(20)>At this rate, the ship will not hold...!<ab(500)><ed()>
rows.notes: Bridge danger alert. Exact tokens preserved.

rows.jp: <op()><sp(20)>機関部に直撃！　総員……<ab(0)><ed()>
